subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: How is "Argus-authored" derived so it is forgery-resistant and available in CI without ambient credentials? (P-2)
rationale: resolved (001) — The attribution-gate derivation property is now contracted in full: the signal is produced by construction on every drive-authored commit, forgery-resistant in strength, badge-independent and credential-free at CI evaluation time (FR-12), with authorship resolved into three positively-established states on the protected subset (FR-13). Q2 remains **open at the mechanism altitude** and is handed to the stage-3 technical design (a supersession of `docs/tech-design/argus-attribution-gate.md`): *how* the signal is produced (producer site — the commit-authoring actor, not the drive prose), *how* forgery-resistance is constructed, *how* human authorship is positively established, and the pre-mechanism/post-mechanism transition rule.
